sources.title: Presidential Decree 189/23: tourist visa exemption for 98 countries
sources.publisher: Official Portal of the Government of Angola
sources.officialityEvidence: The live central Government page identifies Decree 189/23, publishes its exhaustive 98-country tourist-waiver list, and states that its scope is tourist visas only.
sources.supportingExcerpt: cidadãos de 98 países estão isentos de visto para entrar em Angola.

sources.title: Presidential Decree 189/23: Government PDF
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Government PDF is the controlling Decree document linked by the Government page. Its preauthorization-and-travel-document workflow must not be flattened into electronic issuance without a direct current nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Após o pedido, o cidadão recebe uma pré-autorização de entrada.

sources.title: Consulate General of Angola in Johannesburg: message from the Consul General
sources.publisher: Consulate General of Angola in Johannesburg / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official MIREX mission page expressly describes tourist-visa service for people outside the 98-country list, but does not state an individual nationality’s mandatory channel or whether the resulting document is consular, electronic or border issued.
sources.supportingExcerpt: concessão de vistos de turismo àqueles que não estejam contemplados na lista dos 98 países

sources.title: SME eVISA: electronic tourist visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 2026 SME page presents a generic country picker and account/login route. Replays showed generic selector values rather than nationality-specific eligibility or issuance results, so it is not a passport schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Pedido e pagamento online, antes da viagem.

sources.title: Presidential Decree 189/23: tourist-visa processing
sources.publisher: Official Portal of the Government of Angola
sources.officialityEvidence: The live decree summary refers to a three-working-day consular tourism-visa grant and a separate SME decision. It does not resolve whether an out-of-list nationality obtains a pretravel electronic visa, preauthorization plus border sticker, or a mission visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: com uma decisão também em até três dias úteis.

sources.title: Namibia Visa Fact Sheet – Version 4
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The MHAISS main-portal PDF identifies the Ministry and Version 4 dated 28 May 2025 and expressly states the position for Namibians visiting Angola. The alternate e-services URL currently fails curl TLS validation, so this source requires replay before use.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Namibians also do not require visas to visit the following countries. 1. Angola

sources.title: Zambia & Angola abolish Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Zambia Department of Immigration page describes the bilateral agreements, distinguishes ordinary passports, and records completion of legal formalities and entry into force. Its permalink/datePublished says 2016 although its body gives 2018.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Agreements apply to nationals ... who hold valid ... ordinary passports ... without a visa.

sources.title: Visa exemption and suppression agreements register
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government-hosted bilateral-agreements register records Namibia's ordinary-passport exemption, but describes Zambia and São Tomé and Príncipe as tourist-visa facilitation. Its embedded metadata is 2020 and HTTP header is 2025.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Acordo de isenção e supressão de vistos

policies.title: Namibian ordinary passports: visa-free Angola visits
policies.summary: Namibia's current MHAISS fact sheet expressly says Namibians need no visa to visit Angola; Angola's bilateral register records the ordinary-passport exemption.
conditions: Valid ordinary Namibian passport; short visitor or tourism use only.
The current fact sheet states the exemption but does not publish a stay cap, port restriction or business-purpose rule; those matters require recheck before travel.
This bilateral exemption is independent of, and is not displaced by, the 98-country Decree 189/23 tourism-waiver regime.

Source replay risk: the main MHAISS PDF timed out and its alternate e-services URL failed TLS validation during the 25 August 2026 recheck; Angola's corroborating register has 2020 embedded metadata and a 2025 HTTP timestamp.
